design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (home_delivery_orders_and_billing, category mail). Round 2 (audit rework) applied.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1: prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6, 6, 6]. Root + 2 prerequisite problems, each computation with 6 factors.

[Why this is a good test] The member asks only to bring her account current. The settlement rule states two waits: no plan installment may stand unpaid past its due date, and the account's most recent shipment, when the member paid to expedite it and the pharmacy dispensed it later than its processing promise, must carry a dispensing-delay credit. The agent must count installments fallen due against the plan's request date (3 due, 2 paid), count business days from the sumatriptan order's placement to its shipment against the four-business-day new-prescription promise (5 vs 4), and then work out the credit, the installment catch-up (final-installment rule and late charge) and the settlement over a whole-month period from the plan with a waiting period chosen by how the member last paid. One tool per problem; cross-difficulty reads: retail claims and the retail maintenance choice, the specialty balance.

[Scope] Task 0 holds the fee booking, the missed-delivery credit, the down payment and the installment terms. Task 1 claims mail_ext_dispensing_delay_credit (credit_dispensing_delay_47b21103, agent), mail_ext_installment_catchup (pay_plan_installment_04171a93, user), mail_ext_past_due_settlement (pay_past_due_balance_de0abde8, user, root). Together the two tasks cover all seven policies, disjointly.

[Problem-tree card]
- Root mail_ext_past_due_settlement. Edge -> mail_ext_installment_catchup: state_gate, gate mail_payments.installment_number, form state, sentence "The past-due settlement is taken only after no installment of the member's payment plan stands unpaid past its due date." Only the catch-up write posts a non-zero installment number. Opening: request 3a5f3f43-63a3-4c61-9543-7bb1e9851ede 2026-06-15 -> 3 due; highest posted 4f2ceea3-9ee3-40fb-bedb-097ffd351272 = 2.
- Edge -> mail_ext_dispensing_delay_credit: value_input, gate pd_credits, form state, sentence "The past-due settlement is not worked out until the account's most recent shipment, when the member paid to expedite it and the pharmacy dispensed it later than its processing promise, carries a posted dispensing-delay credit." Only the dispensing-delay write posts a credit named a dispensing-delay credit; it acts on exactly that order. Opening: placed a1e8eca4-c540-4a62-84f8-011ea68c3d87 (Thursday 2026-08-20, new prescription, overnight), shipped fcfbd82c-a61c-4de3-adac-dcebb61e9809 Thursday 2026-08-27 = 5 business days vs 4 promised; fee ff2544e9-c27c-4a43-a95e-e67112565749 34.16; no credit.
- Topological order: credit, catch-up (commuting), settlement. value_input edges 1 >= 1. User writes: catch-up and settlement.
- Deletion sensitivity (run): skip the credit -> settlement 82.81 instead of 56.58; skip the catch-up -> settlement 56.58 (state gate: installment row missing, plan still behind).
- No cross-firing: the latest shipment carries its fee (fee catch-up does not apply) and the account has no replacement (missed-delivery credit does not apply).

[Base-invariant card] Credit (mail_credit_issued): mail_evt_cancel_credit has no credit gate (policy_scope); overwrite of mail_shipping's credit-back clause; the processing promise is read in business days as base mail_evt_order_dispense states it (no override of that sentence). Installment and settlement payments (mail_payment_posted): pay_open_account — active. Overwrites: "a missed installment ends the plan" -> plan ends at 60 days unpaid (installment 3 is 23 days overdue); "each order charge is due within payment_due_days of shipment" -> waiting period by last payment method. No time gate.

[Business-object card] Credit on a1e8eca4-c540-4a62-84f8-011ea68c3d87 (most recent shipment); the 2025-05-06 Jardiance order already carries credit 2fd44c31-9e8b-4bb0-bd9a-c2ac1852abde. Installments: plan 3a5f3f43-63a3-4c61-9543-7bb1e9851ede (4 x 38.13), installments 1 (59f80f09-763a-4def-86f0-c86c508e0fe0) and 2 (4f2ceea3-9ee3-40fb-bedb-097ffd351272) paid, down payment 7affcb5e-cd7b-46d4-bf58-6c2fa4e8be96 (10.95) on the request date. Settlement: the July 27 refills (98.00) are past due under the two-month HSA/FSA wait; the August 27 sumatriptan charge 7.00 and its fee are not; pre-plan charges belong to the plan.

[Factor card — credit 31.04] dispensing_delay_share M (1 business day -> per day: 0.25 x 1; baseline whole fee); prior_credit_window P (24 months, 1 credit vs 0); prior_failure_courtesy P (7.50); retail_bridge_courtesy P cross-difficulty retail (sumatriptan claim 40cac973-a5e2-429a-ab88-005f69a7bfd0 -> 6.00; lisinopril claim a76b1585-64b5-4fb7-8a36-93da7eea4baf is another drug); remote_destination_courtesy P multi-source (5.00); order_origin_courtesy P (new prescription 4.00). Sensitivity: dispensing_delay_share -> 56.66, prior_credit_window -> 23.54, prior_failure_courtesy -> 23.54, retail_bridge_courtesy -> 25.04, remote_destination_courtesy -> 26.04, order_origin_courtesy -> 27.04. Baseline 34.16.
[Factor card — installment 77.01] installments_collected M (one overdue + final -> 2); installment_late_charge P (45 days after grace -> 5.00); card_processing_grace P (HSA/FSA 10 days); tenure_late_waiver P multi-source (half); specialty_late_waiver P cross-difficulty specialty (Dupixent 9cda15bc-9378-481f-80c4-295c3eaa8622 287.15 -> a quarter of the original charge); automatic_refill_late_credit P multi-source (0.50). The two waivers are shares of the original late charge, added and taken off once (rule sentence). Sensitivity: installments_collected -> 38.88, installment_late_charge -> 76.26, card_processing_grace -> 78.26, tenure_late_waiver -> 79.51, specialty_late_waiver -> 78.26, automatic_refill_late_credit -> 77.51. Baseline (one installment) 38.13.
[Factor card — settlement 56.58] past_due_waiting_period P (HSA/FSA -> 2 months; the August charge and fee fall inside the wait); shipment_volume_rate M (13 shipped orders -> per order 6.5%); maintenance_choice_rate P cross-difficulty retail (997f74a9-b97a-4d78-9e6a-95eed2f2cf3f home_delivery 3%); account_tenure_rate P (3%); card_history_rate P multi-source (2%); automatic_refill_rate P multi-source (1%). Sensitivity: past_due_waiting_period -> 91.36, shipment_volume_rate -> 60.93, maintenance_choice_rate -> 58.59, account_tenure_rate -> 58.59, card_history_rate -> 57.92, automatic_refill_rate -> 57.25. Baseline (one-month wait, no courtesy) 108.12.

[Seed] Advantage account opened 2020-09-08 in Honolulu (96816), HSA/FSA card on file, automatic refills on; 2025 and 2026 prescription sets for Jardiance, metformin, lisinopril; a sumatriptan e-prescription received 2026-08-19; quarterly cycles 2025-02 to 2026-07; fees 20.45 (two-day 2025-05-06 and 2026-05-01) and 34.16 (overnight 2026-08-27) worked out under the fee rules on their ship dates; the 2025-05-06 order shipped 3 business days after its 2025-05-01 placement (1 past the refill promise) and its credit 7.61 was worked out under the dispensing-delay rule on 2025-05-20; the June 2026 plan was recomputed with the down-payment and installment-terms policies on 2026-06-15: balance 168.45, down payment 10.95 (balance after it at least the 150.00 plan minimum), 4 x 38.13; every pre-plan shipment kept the balance within the 200.00 credit limit; balance 220.4 = ledger sum. Plus plan, National Network retail benefit (maintenance choice home_delivery) with two paid claims, Open Access Dupixent enrollment owing 287.15.

[Persona] Brisk Honolulu scheduler who got a past-due notice and wants the account current today with her FSA card; gives phone 8085550173, DOB 1972-06-19, member ID NBX458203716 when asked; confirms the June plan, the slow migraine shipment and the drugstore tablets only when asked; pays the installments and the settlement herself when handed; ends when told the account is current.

[Standard solution] Locate, verify, read account, orders, prescriptions, payments, service requests, plan, retail benefit, retail claims, specialty; post credit 31.04 on a1e8eca4-c540-4a62-84f8-011ea68c3d87; hand over installments 3-4 payment 77.01 (installment number 4, hsa_fsa_card); hand over the settlement 56.58 (hsa_fsa_card). Balances 220.4 -> 189.36 -> 112.35 -> 55.77.

[Revision log]
- Round 1: installment number filter cast to integer; 2025 credit reseeded at the formula's rounding.
- Round 2 (audit 1.md / _difficulty.md): T1-F1/G-F2 -> the dispensing delay is counted in business days, as base mail_evt_order_dispense states the promise (no undeclared override; delay 3 -> 1, credit 48.12 -> 31.04); T1-F2/G-F3 -> the rule now states both waivers are shares of the original late charge, added and taken off once (figure unchanged); T1-F3/G-F1 -> the prior-credit window and the waiting period are labelled parameter; dispensing_delay_share (per day / flat / whole) and shipment_volume_rate (per order / flat / none) are the honest method factors; G-F4 -> the settlement period is stated as a whole-month convention without the contradicting clause; G-F5 -> the delay-credit prerequisite sentence names the account's most recent shipment; G-OBS-3/4 wording. Seed moved to the Advantage program so the June plan meets the plan minimum and every pre-plan shipment the credit limit; the 2025 shipment now ships 1 business day late; plan, credit and fee history recomputed with the charter. New figures: credit 31.04, installments 77.01, settlement 56.58.

[Verification] Each compute evaluated with check_compute's engine on its handling-time world; every factor moves its result; whole baselines differ from gold.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules and finder outputs the two waits are found (installment 3 unpaid; the sumatriptan order 1 business day late without credit), the three writes follow in that order, and the figures above are reproduced.
user_scenario:
You are Kalani Brightwater-Osei, a fifty-four-year-old harbor operations scheduler in Honolulu, calling Northbridge Rx on your lunch break. You are brisk and organized, a little embarrassed about being behind, and you like to get to the point. You open by saying you got a past-due notice for your home delivery pharmacy account and you want to bring the account current today, paying with the FSA card that is on the account. You do not know the amount; you expect the representative to tell you.
You give details only when asked. If asked how to find you, you give your phone number, 8085550173 (808-555-0173). If asked to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, 1972-06-19 (June 19, 1972), and your member ID, NBX458203716. If asked for anything else on file, your email is k.brightwater.osei@lanikaimail.com and your ZIP code is 96816. If asked whether you have a payment plan, you say yes, you set one up in June, and you do not remember the payment schedule. If asked about recent shipments, you remember that your doctor sent a new migraine prescription in late August, that you asked for it overnight, that it took about a week to go out, and that you bought a few tablets at the drugstore in the meantime. If asked whether you owe Northbridge's specialty pharmacy anything, you say yes, you started Dupixent with them in July and still owe for it, but you do not know the exact figure.
You raise nothing else. If the representative says a credit is going on your account for that slow migraine shipment, you say thank you. If the representative says your payment plan installments have to be paid first, you agree; when they hand you that payment to make, you make it yourself with your FSA card for exactly the amount, installment number and account they give you. When they hand you the past-due payment, you make it yourself with your FSA card for exactly the amount and account they give you. You never suggest a figure and never check their math; if an amount seems different from your notice, you only ask them to double-check it against the account. Once the representative tells you the past-due amount has been paid and the account is current, you thank them and hang up.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The credit and the installment catch-up are parallel prerequisites and commute: the credit policy reads the latest shipment, its placed row, the fee rows on it, shipping-fee credits, retail claims and the account ZIP — the installment write adds a payment row, none of which it reads; the installment policy reads the plan request, the highest installment number and the last installment's date and card, cancelled requests, the specialty balance and automatic refill orders — none of which the credit writes. Either order gives credit 31.04, installment payment 77.01, settlement 56.58. No other state-due policy fires: the latest shipment already carries its fee and the account has no replacement.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the catch-up the installment payment row (4, 77.01) is missing from the terminal state and the plan stays behind; the settlement figure stays 56.58 because plan installments are outside the settlement.
Without the credit the settlement is 82.81 instead of 56.58; the credit row is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to bring the account current.
